subject: Inference Serving candidate: panel ops, evaluator roles, and final scorecard flow
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: recruiter@talentworks.com
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inference Serving candidate: panel ops, evaluator roles, and final scorecard flow

Team — quick sync to lock the panel and flow for Alex Moreno (Staff/Principal Inference candidate). Recruiter pushed availability and we should finalize roles / questions so we run a tight loop and have scorecards ready. High level plan below — please reply with availability + any gating concerns by EOD today.

Candidate basics (from recruiter):
- Alex Moreno — Staff/Principal-level LLM inference engineer, currently at MLStartup (infra team).
- 8 years infra experience, some model-compilation exposure.
- Recruiter confirms work authorization; resume attached.

Proposed panel (60m total, 4x12m interviews + 12m buffer/debrief):
- 12m System Design — Marissa (hiring manager) — focus: serving architecture, routing/fallback strategies
- 12m Runtime Deep-dive — Stephanie — focus: KV cache, batching, kernel tradeoffs, perf debugging
- 12m Reliability & Ops — Grace (bar-raiser candidate) — SLOs, incident playbooks, deployment abstractions
- 12m Behavioral / Leadership — Jasmine (I can moderate) — cross-team collaboration, tradeoffs, mentoring
- 12m Buffer for wrap/clarifying questions + immediate debrief prep

Key asks:
- Confirm you can take the assigned slot or propose a swap. If you want to cover different focus topics, call it out here.
- We need a filled scorecard in greenhouse within 24 hours after the interview; I'll circulate a template and the final copy of the candidate resume (attached).
- If anyone anticipates a conflict-of-interest or if you feel Alex should be screened at a different level, say so now.

Attachments: alex_moreno_resume.pdf (see recruiter copy)

If I don't hear objections, I'll lock the calendar invites for Monday 5/19 10:00am PT and ask TalentWorks to confirm.

Thanks — jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Recruiting Partner (Hiring Ops) — Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inference Serving candidate: panel ops, evaluator roles, and final scorecard flow

Thanks Jas — I'm good for the proposed roles but I'm unavailable Wednesday afternoon (FYI).

Couple of quick edits to my slot:
- For System Design I want to lean into capacity planning and multi-tenant QoS; please include a prompt for a short POA (plan of attack) for handling a noisy-tenant scenario.
- Also, can we ensure the panel asks one explicit question about latency regressions and metrics — I think we should score candidate's approach to monitoring and regression detection (this has tripped us up recently).

Agree on the 24h scorecard expectation. I'll prep 2-3 anchor questions and share by EOD tomorrow.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Serving & Runtime

From: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inference Serving candidate: panel ops, evaluator roles, and final scorecard flow

On Thu, May 15, 2025 at 9:12 AM jasmine.liu@redwood.ai wrote:
> Team — quick sync to lock the panel and flow for Alex Moreno (Staff/Principal Inference candidate). Recruiter pushed availability and we should finalize roles / questions so we run a tight loop and have scorecards ready.

All sounds good. A few technical notes from me:
- For the Runtime Deep-dive please include a prompt to explain KV cache eviction and warm-start strategies for long-context workloads. I also want to hear a concrete example where candidate trades off quantization vs latency and how they measure it.
- I'll bring an instrumentation snippet and one production incident example (short) to probe troubleshooting.

Scorecard items: we should use a 1-5 rubric with these axes: Technical Depth, System Design Pragmatism, Troubleshooting, Communication, Ownership Bias. I'll attach a cleaned template for consistency.

Attachment: scorecard-template.xlsx (editable).

I'll also be OOO early Monday until 9:30am PT but can join the 10:00am PT slot — will be dialing in a minute late unless we shift to 10:15.

—Stephanie
Staff Software Engineer, Inference Runtime

From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: recruiter@talentworks.com
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Alex Moreno panel confirmed + logistics + scorecard link

Thanks for the quick turn. Finalizing plan below after confirming with TalentWorks. Calendar invites are sent for Monday 5/19 10:00–11:12am PT (we kept the 12m blocks plus 12m wrap). Please check your calendar and accept.

Final assignments:
- Marissa — System Design (capacity, QoS, latency regression question)
- Stephanie — Runtime Deep-dive (KV cache, quantization tradeoffs)
- Grace — Reliability & Ops (bar-raiser focus)
- Jasmine — Behavioral / Leadership (moderation + timekeeper)

Backups: Rishi Malhotra (if coverage needed for system design) — I've asked Rishi to be on standby.

Scorecard & post-interview process:
- Use the attached final scorecard (inference_panel_final-scorecard.xlsx). Please fill in a rating 1–5 per axis and a 2–3 sentence recommendation. We will collect scorecards in Greenhouse within 24 hours.
- I pasted the Greenhouse candidate link in case you want to enter notes directly: https://greenhouse.io/harvest/candidate/987654
- Post-interview quick debrief: I'll host a 12-minute room immediately after the interview in the candidate calendar invite; try to stay on for the wrap if possible.

Attachments: inference_panel_final-scorecard.xlsx
Related docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4ExampleLink

If you foresee any issue with timing or the grading rubric, call it out now and we'll adjust. Otherwise I'll ask TalentWorks to send final candidate instructions and the resume to panelists.

—Jasmine
Senior Recruiting Partner (Hiring Ops) — Redwood Inference
